One port serves both protocols; a login and password are always required. Take them from the main
screen (copy buttons):
language-bash shiki shiki-themes material-theme-lighter material-theme material-theme-palenight

curl --socks5-hostname LOGIN:PASSWORD@PHONE_IP:1080 https://api.ipify.org
curl -x http://LOGIN:PASSWORD@PHONE_IP:1080 https://api.ipify.org

Only devices on your local network may connect; the proxy cannot reach your LAN or the phone
itself, and port 25 is closed.
When mobile data drops or changes network, open connections are cut at once.
